title: JavaClassWrapper: Reflection on WindowInsetsControllerCompat triggers NoClassDefFoundError on Android < 30
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in 4.5 beta 5 
- Reproducible in 4.4.1 stable

### System information

Linux Fedora 42

### Issue description

When trying to wrap `androidx.core.view.WindowInsetsControllerCompat`, project crashes on Android devices below API 30 with the following error:


It crashes at this line
https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/0c51ede2434d99d2c80dc87b7df179db66537f1c/platform/android/java_class_wrapper.cpp#L1479-L1480

Since `WindowInsetsControllerCompat` has methods referencing the Android 11+ API class `android.view.WindowInsetsController`, I believe calling `getDeclaredMethods()` forces the runtime to resolve that type. On Android < 30 the class does not exist, leading to a `NoClassDefFoundError` crash.

### Steps to reproduce

Run this method:

```gdscript
func _on_button_pressed() -> void:
	var android_runtime = Engine.get_singleton("AndroidRuntime")
	var activity = android_runtime.getActivity()
	var callable = func ():
		var WindowInsetsControllerCompat = JavaClassWrapper.wrap("androidx.core.view.WindowInsetsControllerCompat")
	
	activity.runOnUiThread(android_runtime.createRunnableFromGodotCallable(callable))

```
